vs_nora.instruct: Teenage girl around sixteen, frightened hushed whisper close to the microphone, trembling breath, American English, telling a true scary story quietly at night.
vs_nora.ref: I'm whispering because I don't want it to hear me. Please, just listen. This really happened.

lines.text: The storm took the power at 2 AM.
lines.say: The storm took the power at two a.m.

lines.text: My phone was dead. All I had was Grandpa's old camera.
Twelve shots left. And a flash that takes forever to charge.
Grandpa had one rule about this house. It only moves in the dark.
There was someone at the end of the hall.
Every time the flash was charging... it got closer.
I locked my door. Five shots left.
The knocking wasn't coming from the door.
Stay in the light. Stay in the light.
Grandpa's photo. Taken in this room. Nineteen sixty-one.
